title: Skywatcher sessions: psionic calls brought benign UAP, the mechanical dog whistle brought aggressive ones

tellings.quote: however every time we did elicit a respon response. Uh the phenomena was highly benign,

plain: In 2024 and 2025, field sessions run by Skywatcher, a group that tries to call in unidentified flying objects, got friendly objects when they reached out with the mind alone and aggressive ones when they used a mechanical device they called a dog whistle. Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a UFO program as a child, says he took part, and that "every time we did elicit a response," the mind-only calls brought a phenomenon that was "highly benign." If true, it would mean the way you call these things changes how they behave.
